description: JME-approved tight PF jet ID for AK4 PUPPI jets, 2017/2018 Ultra Legacy (RUN2ULPUPPI working point). Recomputed from NanoAODv15 per-jet composition branches because NanoAODv15 drops the precomputed Jet_jetId branch that existed in NanoAODv9. Boundary cases with expected_pass=null document scope limits, not physical criteria; consumers MUST skip those cases when validating.
note_2016: 2016 UL uses a distinct, looser working point (enum RUN2UL16PUPPI) with different central-region and forward cuts; NOT interchangeable with 2017/2018 UL (RUN2ULPUPPI). This fixture covers 2018 UL only.
production_relevant_region: |eta| < 2.4 (acceptance end for probe and SM b-jet objects in this analysis); the fixture and doc additionally cover the full |eta| <= 2.6 and 2.6 < |eta| <= 2.7 region structure for completeness, per the primary source's own region boundaries.

primary_used.description: PFJetIDSelectionFunctor: the CMSSW selector functor whose RUN2ULPUPPI/TIGHT branch is the authoritative encoding of the 2017/2018 UL AK4/AK8 PUPPI tight jet ID (the formula that filled the dropped NanoAODv9 Jet_jetId bit for PUPPI-clustered jets).

cross_checks.description: Historical NanoAODv9-era jets_cff.py: for era modifiers run2_nanoAOD_106Xv1/106Xv2 (Run2 UL nanoAOD production) combined with run2_jme_2017/2018 (i.e. NOT run2_jme_2016), tightJetIdAK8.filterParams.version is set to RUN2ULPUPPI (quality TIGHT/TIGHTLEPVETO); the CHS 'Jet' collection uses RUN2ULCHS. Confirms RUN2ULPUPPI is exactly the 2017/2018-UL PUPPI recipe, distinct from RUN2UL16PUPPI (2016).

jetDQMAnalyzerAk4PFCHSPuppiCleanedMiniAOD (jetsrc='slimmedJetsPuppi', i.e. AK4 PUPPI specifically, not just AK8) sets JetIDVersion='RUN2ULPUPPI', JetIDQuality='TIGHT' with comment '#for PUPPI jets: RUN2ULPUPPI from 11_1_X onwards'. Confirms RUN2ULPUPPI applies to AK4 PUPPI, not only AK8 PUPPI.

Run3 (RUN3PUPPIrunsBCDEprompt) correctionlib encoding of the sibling PFJetIDSelectionFunctor branch, cross-checked structurally: independently confirms chMultiplicity>=1 and nConstituents>=2 are genuine POG-published criteria for PUPPI central-region tight ID (not a CHS-only artifact of the C++), corroborating the same unconditional CHF/NCH block also applied to RUN2ULPUPPI. No 2018_UL jetid.json.gz exists in jsonpog-integration (confirms NanoAODv15/2018UL AK4 PUPPI jet ID has no correctionlib shortcut and must be recomputed, matching the premise of this task).

region_convention: Region selection uses |eta| <= 2.6 for 'eta_lt_2p6' (inclusive upper edge: eta==2.6 is IN this region) and 2.6 < |eta| <= 2.7 for 'eta_2p6_to_2p7' (inclusive upper edge: eta==2.7 is IN this region). |eta| > 2.7 is outside the region structure encoded in this fixture (the full formula continues into 2.7-3.0 'EC' and >3.0 'FW' regions per the primary source, recorded in the doc for completeness but out of scope for this fixture/production, since only |eta|<2.4 is production-relevant); such jets are marked with expected_pass=null and region='out_of_scope' by fixture convention, documenting scope limits not physical criteria. Consumers MUST skip cases with expected_pass=null when validating.
cut_convention: All cuts in this formula are strict inequalities (> or <) in the primary source; there are no <=/>= cuts anywhere in the TIGHT working point for RUN2ULPUPPI. A value exactly equal to a threshold therefore FAILS that specific cut.
